title: Card Restriction Rails
summary: Approved concept A: public restriction explanations on the shared card rail, with crowded upright and bowed review positions. Please review the initial coverage and wording; no legality changes or automatic merge.
review_steps: Extract the complete ZIP and open Start Review.cmd. The crowded table has a real Hotako action lock plus clearly synthetic six-token/layout stresses.
Inspect restriction glyphs and their sentences; inspect the attachment and expand/fold its unit. Confirm tokens, permanent grants, copied-card markers and card faces remain readable.
Open Other previews/Bowed Units.cmd and compare the rails below the complete stack, including dishonored and mixed-bow attachments.
Open Other previews/Opposite Seat.cmd. Check that the same public restrictions are visible without hidden-source identities.
Use Advance turn in the prepared review. The turn-bound action lock should disappear; reopen a launcher to reset. A normal game is available through Open Full Game.
Open Other previews/Reduced Motion.cmd and inspect the same layouts. Please record rules-sensitive wording, missing supported states and UI spacing feedback on PR #1274.
known_limitations: Initial priority-systems projection, not every catalogue/global restriction. Historical effects without stored source metadata have no invented source name.
Prepared six-token/copy/grant/movement/protection stresses are synthetic fixtures; Hotako action refusal and turn expiry use the real engine.
Automated Windows runtime/launcher checks do not constitute Mendon’s native graphical playtest or rules acceptance.
This public preview contains the game’s required existing artwork and approved restriction derivative. It is not a separate bulk artwork/research release.
No #1201 used-action indicator is included. This review never merges or accepts the change automatically.
